page_title: ATBCmder — Two panels. Zero clicks. The High-Performance Dual-Panel File Manager for macOS
meta_description: Say goodbye to scattered Finder windows and endless mouse dragging. Blending the classic Commander keyboard-first paradigm with modern macOS Retina aesthetics, ATBCmder puts high-speed file orchestration, instant universal preview, and remote NAS sync right at your fingertips.
hero_banner: 🚀 Crafted Exclusively for macOS · Universal Binary: Apple Silicon (M1–M4) & Intel (x86_64) · Geek Efficiency File Manager
hero_title_h2: Retake Full Control of Your Mac Filesystem
hero_desc: Say goodbye to scattered Finder windows and endless mouse dragging. Blending classic Commander full-keyboard workflow with modern macOS Retina design, orchestrate tens of thousands of files, read 30+ formats instantly, and sync across remote servers—all without leaving your keyboard.
hero_badge_1: ⚡ 100% Keyboard-Driven · Keep Hands on Home Row
theme1_title: Dual columns, zero clicks. Pure keyboard flow accelerates file transfers.
theme1_desc: Optimized natively for Apple Silicon and Intel architecture for ultra-fluid performance.
theme2_title: Ditch heavy standalone apps. Tap a key to inspect retina images, docs, and media.
theme3_title: Local disks, NAS, and cloud servers unified in one place. As smooth as a local SSD.
theme4_title: Insight into every gigabyte. Disk space panoramic analysis, deep app cleanup, and sync.
theme5_title: Millisecond access across millions of files. Reach your target before your fingers leave the keys.
theme5_badge_3: Feed Search Results Directly to Panel
spec_arch_desc: Fully optimized natively for Apple Silicon (M1–M4) and Intel x86_64.
spec_sec_desc: Mac App Store sandboxing, Apple notarization, and automatic silent background updates.
spec_keys_desc: Seamlessly toggle between classic Total Commander (F3–F10) and native macOS (Cmd/Opt) keyboard layouts.
